#!/usr/bin/env bash
# search_mirror.qmd — Search code mirror files by query string.
#
# Uses QMD BM25 search when available, falls back to grep.
# Add --semantic flag for vector similarity search (requires qmd + embeddings).
#
# Scopes to: <repo>/.knowledge/code-mirror/ (or akms-<repo>-code-mirror collection)
#
# Usage: run_qmd.sh search_mirror "query string" [--semantic]

set -euo pipefail

QUERY="${1:?Usage: search_mirror <query> [--semantic]}"
SEMANTIC="${2:-}"

# Resolve the repo and its knowledge directory. A copy installed at
# <repo>/.knowledge/qmd/ (or the older <repo>/knowledge/qmd/) uses the
# directory it sits in. The copy bundled in the akms package is run with the
# repo as its working directory, and picks .knowledge/ unless only the older
# knowledge/ exists.
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
case "$(basename "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")")" in
    .knowledge|knowledge)
        KNOWLEDGE_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
        REPO_ROOT="$(dirname "$KNOWLEDGE_DIR")"
        ;;
    *)
        REPO_ROOT="$(pwd)"
        if [ -d "$REPO_ROOT/.knowledge" ] || [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT/knowledge" ]; then
            KNOWLEDGE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/.knowledge"
        else
            KNOWLEDGE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/knowledge"
        fi
        ;;
esac
MIRROR_DIR="$KNOWLEDGE_DIR/code-mirror"
REPO_NAME="$(basename "$REPO_ROOT")"

HAS_QMD=false
if command -v qmd &>/dev/null; then
    HAS_QMD=true
fi

echo "=== Code Mirror ==="
if [ "$HAS_QMD" = true ]; then
    if [ "$SEMANTIC" = "--semantic" ]; then
        qmd search "$QUERY" --semantic --collection "akms-${REPO_NAME}-code-mirror" 2>/dev/null || {
            echo "(qmd collection not found — falling back to grep)"
            if [ -d "$MIRROR_DIR" ]; then
                grep -ril --include="*.md" "$QUERY" "$MIRROR_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no matches)"
            else
                echo "(no code-mirror directory)"
            fi
        }
    else
        qmd search "$QUERY" --collection "akms-${REPO_NAME}-code-mirror" 2>/dev/null || {
            echo "(qmd collection not found — falling back to grep)"
            if [ -d "$MIRROR_DIR" ]; then
                grep -ril --include="*.md" "$QUERY" "$MIRROR_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no matches)"
            else
                echo "(no code-mirror directory)"
            fi
        }
    fi
else
    echo "(qmd not installed — using grep fallback)"
    if [ -d "$MIRROR_DIR" ]; then
        grep -ril --include="*.md" "$QUERY" "$MIRROR_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "(no matches)"
    else
        echo "(no code-mirror directory)"
    fi
fi
